verdict.rationale: AgentMail is documented as a hosted email API and MCP service. The only self-hosting signal is a single community comment that its enterprise options include "Bring Your Own Cloud", which suggests a deployment into the customer's own cloud on enterprise terms. missing for 10: first-party documentation of BYOC or self-hosted deployment, open-source or downloadable server components, installation/operations guides, availability outside enterprise contracts, and hands-on corroboration that the core product runs on user-controlled infrastructure.
